name: Fresh Canna Live Resin | Wedding Cake
description: Indulge in the rich, creamy goodness of Fresh Canna’s Live Resin Wax – Wedding Cake, a powerful hybrid known for its sweet flavor and deeply relaxing effects. Crafted from fresh-frozen cannabis, this terpene-loaded live resin wax delivers a smooth, flavorful, and potent dabbing experience. With sweet vanilla, creamy dough, and subtle earthy spice, Wedding Cake delivers a blissful euphoria that uplifts the mind while melting away stress and tension. Perfect for unwinding, creative bursts, or just kicking back, this strain brings the perfect balance of relaxation and mental clarity.
